verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents several APIs, including Job Board, Candidate Ingestion, Assessment Partner and webhooks, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference with runnable examples or a try-it console. The pricing page's 'Developer sandbox & sync' is a test environment, not an interactive API reference, so it earns no credit. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404, so no machine-readable spec backs an interactive explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
